project.name: smb-roi-calculator
project.summary: One HTML document performs browser-side automation-cost estimates, updates a Chart.js comparison and serializes scenario values in a shareable URL fragment; there is no application backend.

nodes.label: Scenario sliders
nodes.summary: Eight sliders combine business inputs and automation assumptions.

nodes.label: Savings and ROI calculations
nodes.summary: calculate computes monthly savings, payback and horizon ROI from the slider state.

nodes.label: Metrics and chart
nodes.summary: Updates metric tiles, the payback bar and cumulative cost datasets.

nodes.label: URL scenario sharing
nodes.summary: Reads and writes numeric state in the fragment and copies a scenario URL.

nodes.label: Chart.js CDN
nodes.summary: Provides the Chart constructor; despite the single-file layout, this is an external script dependency.

edges.label: Replace fragment and update share URL
edges.description: Replace fragment and update share URL.

edges.label: Restore numeric fragment values on initialization
edges.description: Restore numeric fragment values on initialization.

steps.note: Read employee, hours, labor cost, software and automation assumptions.
Estimate labor savings using weeks per month and automation percentages; subtract tool cost for net savings.
Refresh metric tiles, horizon ROI and cumulative cost lines.
Replace the URL fragment with the current slider values.

flows.title: Restore and copy a shared scenario

steps.note: Read known fragment keys and convert each to Number; there is no explicit range or finite-number validation.
Assign restored values and wire slider input listeners.
Initialize the externally loaded chart before the first calculation.
Copy the current scenario URL through the Clipboard API when requested.

tour.title: Estimates, not observed business results
tour.note: The calculation is deterministic client-side arithmetic using assumptions. Software spend affects both chart cost series but is not deducted again from net savings.

tour.title: Single document does not mean offline app
tour.note: Chart.js loads from a CDN and initChart runs before calculate. This application was not run; only the separate architecture export is offline-tested.

tour.title: Sharing stores state in the URL
tour.note: No backend saves a scenario. Fragment values are converted to numbers without explicit validation and clipboard permissions depend on the browser.
